rootCause: F-1, and it is the floor rather than the code below it: the app cannot boot at this head, so nothing this unit built exists in the product. The built main bundle dies at module load — `dist/main/main.cjs:38480` runs esbuild's CJS shim `createRequire(import_meta.url)` with `import_meta = {}`, generated from `node_modules/provident-storeroom/index.mjs:94-97`, which is ESM-only and resolves its native addon through `import.meta.url`. Measured: Electron spawned on the landed vector with a fresh scratch profile (seeded `provident-security.json`) answers `App threw an error during load / TypeError [ERR_INVALID_ARG_VALUE] ... Received undefined` on stderr, emits ZERO stdout bytes in 45 s, and leaves no `provident-operator-settings.json` in the profile — the instance never constructs, so the exclusion pair, the three channels, `attach` and every absence row of D-18 describe a process that never starts. `main.cjs` is the ONLY output that carries the seam, and nothing in the verification floor reaches it: `battery-host.mjs` and `standalone.mjs` carry none of it (measured 0 occurrences of the package, of `createProfileStore` and of `import.meta`; `src/main/battery-host.ts:12`'s import is unused and tree-shaken, and neither host passes a `dataSurface`), so the 184 green checks of `tests/e2e-battery.test.mjs` say nothing about the seam; vitest imports `src/**` as ESM TS and never loads a bundle; and `npm run build` exits 0 with NO warning at this esbuild version. The defect is reachable from the earlier seam (`src/main/data/store.ts:23` -> `src/main/storeroom.ts:21`), so it predates this unit; this unit adds the second importer (`src/main/operator-settings/index.ts:27`) and its instance is the first thing the boot would construct, which is what makes a host-side build defect the constraint this unit inherits. The two legs that DO boot the bundle cannot see it either, because neither bounds its handshake (F-2: measured 26-minute hang, no verdict). Host-side, so it is closed by a regression row that runs the built bundle and requires a stdio handshake, not by a green node row. Not a rebuild: the two modules, their declared surfaces, the composition and both batteries are sound and measured; one seam/bundle contract, one unexercised seam and one unbounded harness wait are what is broken. F-3 is a figure correction beside them.
